bio: Jacqueline Irwin (née Van Egmond; born January 3, 1962) is an American politician who is the U.S. representative-elect for California's 26th congressional district. Prior to winning the House seat she served in the California State Assembly. She is a Democrat representing the 42nd Assembly district, having previously represented the 44th.
